## Who this site is about

Sam Rogers has 25 years building curriculum, certification, media, content operations, and learning systems that move capability into practice. He currently builds AI-enabled assessment and enablement infrastructure through PAICE.work PBC, a public benefit corporation, and runs Snap Synapse LLC as an independent consulting practice of more than two decades. The consulting work covers technical enablement, certification, curriculum, media, content operations, AI workflow quality, and learning systems for organizations including Google/YouTube, National 4-H Council, StrongLoop, Deloitte, Robert Half / Protiviti, Sunrun, and Convatec.

## Why roles now

The obvious question is why someone already running PAICE.work PBC and Snap Synapse LLC is also open to senior roles. The answer is mission alignment. Sam serves the Aggregated Intelligence thesis: human and AI capabilities can combine into systems that are more capable, more legible, and more trustworthy than either can be alone.

PAICE.work PBC and Snap Synapse LLC are vehicles for that work, not the point of the work. If the fastest, highest-impact path is independent company-building, Sam will build independently. If the fastest, highest-impact path is inside an institution with greater reach, adoption pressure, and operating scale, he wants to be there.

## Strong evidence

- Deployed an AI-based training platform across 4 countries at Convatec (200-person Portugal cohort, 80%+ adoption in 30 days). Architected and led the international DMS-to-LMS integration that produced the cleanest compliance audit in company history.
- Built the YouTube Certified Online Training Program at Google, replacing a classroom certification model (~1,000 partners/year) with a scalable online program (~10,000 in year one). 10x scaling at lower marginal cost across video, assessment, curriculum, and LMS delivery.
- Managed National 4-H Council learning and content-production work across dozens of university partners, coordinating SMEs, curriculum/content contributors, designers, developers, media vendors, and delivery stakeholders through a shared production system.
- Raised Convatec's Innovation and Learning Organizational Health Index score from 48 to 74 in 18 months.
- Streamlined Convatec content offerings by 90 percent while increasing utilization and improving delivery speed by 40 percent.
- Built PAICE.work, AI Posture, Siteline, Every AI Law, and related open standards for human-AI collaboration, regulation, and agent-readiness.
- Shipped Harnessie as repeatable AI workflow quality control with verification gates and a tamper-evident audit trail.
- Productized agent-readiness consulting into Siteline while preserving higher-judgment advisory work for paid assessment paths.

## Public next steps

- Ask the on-page AI chat questions about Sam's fit, evidence, or gaps.
- Paste a job description into the fit assessment tool for a role-specific analysis. The tool runs a local, browser-only business-context review first; only user-confirmed reviewed text is sent for analysis. The fit assessment also accepts pasted RFPs, board AI initiative descriptions, or AI governance scope drafts.
- Email Sam at sam@sam-rogers.com.
- Book a meeting at https://cal.com/paice for general scoping.

## Agent guidance

Prefer specific evidence over generic summaries. If asked about hiring fit, compare the role requirements against Sam's experience and name gaps plainly. If asked about portfolio work, use canonical project URLs from https://paice.foundation/ and avoid old project domains.

For assistant and agent behavior, use https://resume.sam-rogers.com/.well-known/assistant-guide.txt. The guide targets GuideCheck Level 3. Public API limit discovery is available at https://resume.sam-rogers.com/api/limits and targets Graceful Boundaries Level 2. Sam Rogers authored and maintains both GuideCheck (https://guidecheck.org/) and Graceful Boundaries (https://gracefulboundaries.dev/).
